name: Cessna Citation Sovereign (680)
summary: Cessna's mid-size Citation with a swept wing and T-tail, a popular corporate and charter workhorse sitting between the Excel and the Citation X in size.

wings: Low, moderately swept wing (far less sweep than the Citation X)
Sovereign+ has upturned winglets; earlier aircraft have plain tips
engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW306 turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Long, slim fuselage with a row of oval windows
tail: T-tail with a swept fin and swept horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Swept wing and T-tail on a slim Citation-style body, with the wing noticeably less swept than the fastest Citation
Winglets on later aircraft, plain swept tips on earlier ones
Rear-mounted pods and a long row of oval windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The Sovereign's wing is only moderately swept and its tailplane is smaller; the Citation X has a dramatically swept wing and a bigger, sharper T-tail.
The Latitude has a visibly wider, rounder fuselage with a bigger cabin; the Sovereign is slimmer, and only the Sovereign+ has winglets.
The Excel has a straight (unswept) wing and a low-set tailplane; the Sovereign has a swept wing and a T-tail.
The Citation III/VII has smaller, rounder windows and no winglets; the Sovereign has larger oval windows and a more modern wing (winglets on the Sovereign+).
